mainEntity.name: What kind of finishes are available for interior walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: For interior walls, a range of finishes is available, each offering distinct aesthetics and durability. Common options include flat/matte, eggshell, satin, and semi-gloss. Flat finishes hide imperfections well but are less washable, ideal for low-traffic areas. Eggshell and satin provide a slight sheen, increased durability, and are easier to clean, making them popular for living areas and bedrooms. Semi-gloss offers high durability and a noticeable sheen, best for trim, doors, and high-moisture areas like bathrooms or kitchens. Your choice should balance appearance with functional needs for each room.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior wall finishes range from flat/matte for low-traffic areas to eggshell, satin, and semi-gloss for increased durability and washability, suitable for different room needs.
